summary: CNL Strategic Residential Credit filed an 8-K/A to correct a scrivener's error in a prior Form 8-K regarding a First Amendment to a Loan and Security Agreement with Valley National Bank. The amendment permits up to $5.0 million of the $15 million revolving credit line to satisfy liquidity covenants under repurchase facilities. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change occurred. The filing also reports a routine NAV determination and offering price adjustment for the non-traded REIT's shares. This is a routine financing amendment and net asset value update, not a special situation.
